channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: In Orlando, Florida, a tense standoff unfolds in a convenience store when an officer finds a delivery driver being restrained by an employee; in Sacramento, California, a ride-share trip turns into a nightmare as a passenger tries to take control of the car; a tow truck driver in Memphis, Tennessee, is run over while attempting to repossess a vehicle; and in a Thailand convenience store, a customer lights the counter on fire during a robbery attempt.
